name: Reactive Resume
description: Builds and edits resumes, cover letters and job applications in an open-source resume builder that agents reach through its MCP server and REST API.

skills.name: Edit Resumes
skills.description: Reads and edits resumes with JSON Patch, recording every AI change in version history so earlier versions can be restored.

skills.name: Export Resumes
skills.description: Exports resumes as PDF, DOCX, ODT, Markdown or JSON, and returns signed PDF download links that expire in 10 minutes.

skills.name: Write Cover Letters
skills.description: Creates, updates, duplicates and exports cover letters, optionally linked to a resume for its sender details and design.

skills.name: Track Job Applications
skills.description: Tracks job applications by stage with contacts, notes, interviews and attached PDFs, and moves or imports them in bulk.

skills.name: Tailor Resume to Job
skills.description: Tailors a private resume copy to a job posting and scores the match, using the AI provider you connected to your account.
